d:
The Magic defeated the Nets, 113-111 tonight in Brooklyn. Franz Wagner finished with a team-high 35 points along with 7 assists and 5 rebounds for the Magic, while Desmond Bane tallied 21 points, 7 three pointers and 5 steals in the game. Julius Randle recorded 27 points, 9 rebounds and 6 assists. The Magic improve their record to 7-8 with the win, while the Nets fall to 3-12 for the season.
